trait.name: Hold Breath
entries: The lizardfolk can hold its breath for 15 minutes.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The lizardfolk makes one Bite attack and one Bone Pike attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) Piercing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) Poison damage.
